static_traits.name: Lin Ruolan
static_traits.educational_background: A Student studying at a small community college
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness history; no prior psychotherapy history; not yet had similar problem experiences
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative; tone rather negative, repeated Self-doubt; able to describe distress and emotions in Work scenarios concretely

basic_info.main_problem: I believe I was transferred to the hospital's new department because my Work was very poor, which led to my Self-doubt and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts and feelings are affecting my confidence at work and overall happiness, so I decided to seek counseling.

special_situations.event: After being transferred to a new hospital department, the supervisor explained it was 'we need your experience', but the client believes this is an excuse
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If transferred, it must be because I performed poorly; others will not tell me their real negative evaluations
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks comfort and reassurance from colleagues and supervisors, but inside continuously doubts their sincerity
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being perfunctory with me; the real reason is I did very poorly

special_situations.event: Facing unfamiliar new processes and tasks in the new department
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get it right the first time, it means I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces interaction with colleagues, avoids proactively seeking help, chooses to hide after making mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am going to mess this up again, just like everything else

special_situations.event: Supervisor occasionally expresses thanks for Work, colleagues give Average comfort
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is unreliable; others are just kindly comforting and not genuinely approving
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keep seeking external reassurance, but quickly negate the value of positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is not sincere; they are just saying it

special_situations.event: Feeling high pressure and Anxiety when facing new challenges or tasks at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only when I receive explicit affirmation from others do I have value; otherwise it means I am bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly seeking recognition and confirmation from colleagues or supervisors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If they do not affirm me, it means I am no good

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted; hopes her abilities will be genuinely affirmed at work
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and seen as incompetent, worrying others hide their real negative evaluations
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by seeking reassurance and staying cautious; avoiding exposing inadequacy to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.object_representation: Others who comfort superficially but do not truly understand, possibly hiding real negative evaluations (supervisors/colleagues)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When told 'the transfer is because your experience is needed' or invited in counseling to accept positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think the other is being perfunctory or hiding real negative evaluations (transference: others are insincere)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a cautious, questioning tone, emphasizing 'this is just an excuse/politeness', avoiding deeply accepting positive information.

manifestations: Difficulty connecting with new colleagues and actively seeking help
The sense of disparity from feeling 'nobody truly understands me' at Work
The new position bringing greater responsibility and choice pressure
Worry about uncertain outcomes and responsibility Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When needing help, restrains the help-seeking impulse and chooses to tough it out alone
After making mistakes, wants to hide and avoid direct contact with colleagues

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-doubt, emphasizing 'I am not good enough / I will fail'
Hard to accept positive feedback, persistently judges oneself by negative standards

exception_events.target_problem: In Work situations facing new tasks or challenges, the client usually falls into Self-doubt and Anxiety, believes their performance is very poor, and finds it hard to accept positive feedback.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On several occasions after tasks ended, the supervisor thanked her for her efforts; that day, after making a mistake, she still did her best to correct it and complete the task, and received a positive response.
exception_events.reason: Clues: she proactively tried to fix problems after mistakes (different actions); the supervisor noticed her efforts and gave thanks (different support), hence a different outcome from past Self-denial.

positive_force: Has transferable work experience (the transfer notice shows demand for her experience)
Proactively corrects mistakes and persists in completing tasks
Willing to try counseling and explore alternative explanations
Has a few friends to confide in
negative_force: Dysfunctional thinking patterns such as overgeneralization, jumping to conclusions, personalization
Over-reliance on external approval and negating positive feedback
Difficulty connecting with and seeking help from new colleagues
Anxiety affecting sleep and Learning focus, further weakening Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-doubt and Anxiety in Work scenarios (with avoiding seeking help, negating positive feedback)
antecedent: After being transferred to a new department, negative interpretation of the transfer reason
Facing unfamiliar new processes and tasks
Receiving positive feedback/comfort from supervisors or colleagues
Taking on new responsibilities in a high-pressure environment
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core belief about one's own abilities ('I am not good enough') and cognitive distortions (overgeneralization, mind reading, personalization, negating the positive), plus high dependence on external approval.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the threat of potential failure and negative evaluation, seeking comfort and external confirmation to temporarily relieve Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected; building relationships with colleagues and seeking help limited; Anxiety worsened and affecting sleep and Learning focus.
